question.text: The Principal Officer (AML) of Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund is preparing monthly PMLA reports. Under the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, the reporting entity must maintain records of ALL cash transactions above what threshold?

explanation.text: The Logic: PMLA and Maintenance of Records Rules require AIFs (and other reporting entities) to maintain records of all cash transactions of value MORE THAN INR 10 lakh (or foreign-currency equivalent). Integrally connected series aggregating above INR 10 lakh in a month are also captured. Cross-border wires have a separate INR 5 lakh threshold. The Trap: Option A (INR 5 lakh) is the cross-border wire threshold — mixed up. Options B and D inflate the figure. Cross-Exam Context: XXIV (AML) tests the full threshold tree. XIX-E cares about the INR 10 lakh CTR and INR 5 lakh cross-border wire number. Manager's Pro-Tip: AIFs rarely deal in cash, but capital contributions from HNIs/family offices can occasionally touch cash. Your KYC workflow should flag any cash-adjacent pattern for STR escalation to FIU-India.
